parsed.observations: Wheat leaves show numerous scattered orange-brown, round to oval pustules, with some yellowing and brown leaf tips. No vein-aligned pustule stripes or black dots within necrotic blotches are visible. White cottony material is mainly on the growing medium, without clear powdery colonies on wheat tissue.
parsed.summary: Visible symptoms are most consistent with leaf rust, supported by scattered orange-brown pustules on the leaf blades.
